normal.text: 🎮 **I can't handle handle horror, so these 6 cozy Halloween games are what I always reach for** Love the spooky season's vibe but don't want the scares? Well, here are 6 cozy Halloween games I'd recommend trying 📰 Source: Latest from GamesRadar+ 🔗 […] [Original post on igeek.gamer-geek-news.com]
normal.media: image: Image for: I can't handle handle horror, so these 6 cozy Halloween games are what I always reach for

normal.name: SethTheHex
normal.text: I really can't feel sorry for slamming this when there's devs sacrificing everything for YEARS to make games like Stardew and Dwarf Fortress, yet you think 2 months of development on something you've always "loved doing" will produce a good result?

normal.name: American Century of BOO-miliation
normal.text: Welcome to Stardew Valley! This is Pierre's, the town's biggest and whiniest supplier of seeds, baking goods, and gardening needs, as well as the sole provider of courtship gifts and the only magistrate who can solemnize a marriage. Across town? The evil monopolist.

normal.name: PLYSE
normal.text: WEEKEND QUEUE 🎃 Halloween weekend. Pick your mood: 🧟 something scary 🧸 something cozy ⚔️ something big Reply with the game you're playing.

normal.name: Thomas Bell
normal.text: This is the Sims 2. Sorry but there's really no comparison. Waaaay down maybe you get Rome Total War Sid Meier's Pirates Insaniquarium was my comfort for a couple of years Last Bow Man or Bullettime Fighting, I didn't know that sort of game was an option?

normal.name: DJ Plague Mouse nearly napping, suddenly there came a tapping
normal.text: I need a new calm game to play. I think I’ve been playing just stressful insane games which have their place, but it is now COZY GAME time and I am playing Sqeakross too What is a cozy game you recommend?

normal.name: Nathewulf Art, Mayor of Halloween
normal.text: Something cozy about the bleakness of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. The silence, the mutants, the inevitably the any moment can be a game over

normal.name: Fi, Weird Writer Lady
normal.text: Always fun to see Nippon Ichi just doing...whatever the fuck they want. Dungeon crawler with both lesbians and like 27 fuckers beating up things in a dungeon? Sure. Farming sim horror game that makes the horror somewhat optional? Fuck it why not. Action rpg spinoff? Yep!
normal.media: quotes @caseyexplosion.bsky.social: The English language update for Village in the Shade is out now, was extremely looking forward to this, practically vibrating with anticipa…

normal.name: Chal, resident manatee boyfriend
normal.text: It's like YA KNOW WHAT STARDEW VALLEY AND STORY OF SEASONS WAS MISSING? EXISTENTIAL TERROR. This game was tailor made for my brain

normal.name: Jeriah
normal.text: Welcome to Elderfield and Tenebris Somnia have released, so the next one I'm looking forward to is Neverway. :o store.steampowered.com/app/2318330/...

normal.name: Chris Biagini-Foote (they/them)
normal.text: Usagi Shima (and Fields of Mistria) have been my go-to games to decompress lately. It’s been fun to see when a new bunny will appear and what they’ll be like (the naruto bun is one of my favs). If you’re looking for a cute & relaxing game that can also be played as on idle game, then you’re in luck
normal.media: video: Vertical video with gameplay above and my wearing a pink headset below. Gameplay shows petting bunnies, placing building on a cute island, playing a run & jump…

normal.name: SundropJo💜
normal.text: Holy fuck that was a stressful hour and an half but got everything sorted out. The stress sweat be sweating. It felt like many more hours that just that lol. I need some cozy game time the rest of the day lol

heated.name: I Do Stuff
heated.text: It's just a game to him. Political chess. The winner takes home the most pork. It doesn't matter that the other party has been flipping the board over and throwing the table since the 1980s because none of that affects him in his cozy life.

heated.name: Drift
heated.text: Tavern Manager Simulator was a nice relaxing game, it didn't blow me out of the water, but in a sea of AI generated sim games, I was happy this one wasn't. store.steampowered.com/app/2756770/...
